messages:
sam: Heads-up — saw p99 jump to ~780ms across prod-serving pool at 02:14. I pushed a quick revert PR that rolls back the connpool change: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4572. Need one reviewer to approve+merge ASAP. @cheng @lina
ops-bot: ALERT: prod-serving p99 latency > 700ms for 3m (region: us-east-1). Incident ID: INC-2029-331. Notifying oncall. :rotating_light:
cheng: On it. Can you paste the PR diff and any relevant logs?
sam: Diff is tiny — reverted the connpool refactor commit. Snippet:
```
- PoolSize = dynamicFromEnv()
+ PoolSize = 64  # revert to stable value
```
Logs: `2026-03-17T02:12:53Z prod-serving-1 p99 780ms + connection errors 0.8%`
lina: If merge goes through we should canary to a subset first. I can review in ~10m. @sam can you add a quick description of rollback risk?
sam: Risk: short window where in-flight requests may retry, but rollback reduces tail latency. No DB schema or protocol changes. I've added PR description now.
maya: Also, can we hold autoscaler adjustments during canary? Want to avoid scale noise. @deploy-bot can we create a canary rollout to 10%? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/prod-serving/10pct (zones: us-east-1a). Estimated 2 min to shift traffic.
cheng: Reviewing PR now — two tiny nits: 1) test name typo, 2) add comment on why we hardcode 64. Otherwise LGTM.
sam: Fixed both, pushed new commit (squash).
lina: Watching dashboards — beginning canary shift. p99 down to ~200ms already in canary subset. Good sign.
cheng: Approving PR now.
sam: Thx. Merging once CI passes.
ops-bot: CI: build 9854 passed, integration tests ok.
lina: Merge done. Observability: p99 for merged pool now ~120ms across regions. Marking as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
maya: Nice. I'll open a follow-up ticket to revisit connpool rollout + add test that simulates tail latency. Assigning to infra team.
cheng: Recommend monitoring for 15 more minutes then close incident.
sam: Thanks all for quick eyes — adding notes to the PR and incident.
deploy-bot: Canary -> rollforward: all traffic shifted to reverted revision. Rollback window closed.
